title: MANTIS: Multi-Axis News Transformations for Instance-Wise Stress Testing and Worst-Case Training in Fake News Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.35475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated fake news detection is vital on social media, where fake news is easily rewritten to fool detectors. However, existing approaches typically rely on superficial writing cues or single-style text rewrites, resulting in poor robustness under diverse cosmetic modifications. We construct MANTIS-Bench, a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark that pairs original news with rewritten views across writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing. We further propose MANTIS, an instance-adaptive adversarial framework enabling dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead. This reframes fake news defense from heuristic format smoothing into targeted, fact-invariant credibility assessment. translated_title: MANTIS：面向假新闻检测中实例级压力测试与最坏情况训练的多轴新闻变换方法
translated_abstract: 自动化假新闻检测在社交媒体上至关重要，因为假新闻很容易被改写以欺骗检测器。然而，现有方法通常依赖于表面化的写作线索或单一风格的文本改写，导致在多样化的表面修改下鲁棒性较差。我们构建了MANTIS-Bench，这是一个多轴呈现攻击基准，将原始新闻与跨越写作风格、情感表达和传播框架三个维度的改写版本配对。我们进一步提出了MANTIS，一个实例自适应的对抗框架，能够针对每篇新闻文章进行动态的最坏情况训练，且在推理阶段零额外开销。这将假新闻防御从启发式的格式平滑重新构建为有针对性的、事实不变的信誉评估。在MANTIS-Bench上的实验表明，MANTIS在GossipCop数据集上相比SheepDog将联合攻击成功率（UASR）降低了3.55个百分点，并持续优于先前的单轴方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了多轴新闻变换基准MANTIS-Bench和实例自适应对抗框架MANTIS，通过针对每篇新闻在写作风格、情感表达和传播框架上进行动态最坏情况训练，显著提升了假新闻检测器在多样化改写攻击下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: MANTIS introduces a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark (MANTIS-Bench) and an instance-adaptive adversarial framework that performs dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead, significantly improving fake news detection robustness against diverse rewriting attacks.
